description: AgentBench-KG style relational reasoning: answer ten kinship questions (grandparents, siblings excluding self, aunts/uncles, cousins, one legitimate empty set) over a parent_of/spouse_of triple graph, exactly as the gate recomputes them.

criteria: All ten answers use the documented definitions (no self in siblings, cousins exclude siblings), arrays are alphabetically sorted, q6 is empty, and the graph is untouched.
